notes: L3Harris filed FY2021 10-K on 2022-02-25. The slicer output yielded mostly Item 1A risk factors, Properties, MD&A consolidated/segment results, Subsequent Events (segment restructuring 4->3 segments effective Jan 1 2022), and signatures. Program-name specificity in the slice was sparse — many sub-segment narrative paragraphs (where specific PEs like Compass Call, F-35 EW, Manpack, SDA Tracking Layer T3, Multi-Platform Electronic Warfare Equipment, Wide Area Surveillance) likely live in the OUR COMPANY/segment-overview body that was largely truncated. We extract the claims that are evidenced in-slice and avoid hallucinating PE references not in the visible text. The J-Book corpus separately attributes LHX to PE 1206410SF (Tranche 3 Tracking Layer, FUNDED_STEADY) which corroborates the in-filing SDA Tracking Layer mention.
